name: WMUIMaps
description: Native map surface built on react-native-maps, rendering Google Maps on Android, and on iOS when the app has an iOS Google Maps key (Apple Maps otherwise). Drops pins from a dataset, draws a route between points, and shows the device location. Native only — there is no web preview, so exercise it on a device or emulator.

provider.name: provider
provider.description: Map SDK on iOS. google renders Google Maps when the app has an iOS Google Maps API key (iosGoogleMapsApiKey in RN preferences) and falls back to Apple Maps without one; default always renders Apple Maps. Android always renders Google Maps. Default: google

mapType.name: mapType
mapType.description: Map style. Apple Maps has no terrain style and falls back to standard. Default: standard

customMapStyle.name: customMapStyle
customMapStyle.description: Google Maps style array as a JSON string, used to restyle roads, labels and terrain. Google Maps only: Android, or iOS with the google provider.

latitude.name: latitude
latitude.description: Latitude the map is centered on. Rebinding it recenters the map. Default: 12.9716

longitude.name: longitude
longitude.description: Longitude the map is centered on. Rebinding it recenters the map. Default: 77.5946

zoom.name: zoom
zoom.description: Zoom level of the camera. 0 is the whole world, 12 a city, 16 a street and 20 a building. Default: 12

markers.name: markers
markers.description: Rows to drop as pins. A row may also carry color to tint its own pin, imageUrl to replace it with an image, and radius for its own coverage circle. Example: [{latitude: 12.9716, longitude: 77.5946, title: 'Bengaluru'}]

latitudeField.name: latitudeField
latitudeField.description: Row field holding the latitude, in both markers and route path. Default: latitude

longitudeField.name: longitudeField
longitudeField.description: Row field holding the longitude, in both markers and route path. Default: longitude

titleField.name: titleField
titleField.description: Marker row field shown as the callout title. Default: title

descriptionField.name: descriptionField
descriptionField.description: Marker row field shown as the callout subtitle. Default: description

markerColor.name: markerColor
markerColor.description: Pin color used when a row carries no color of its own. Google Maps keeps only the hue of the color. Default: #EF4444

markerIcon.name: markerIcon
markerIcon.description: Image URL drawn in place of the default pin for every marker. A row may override it with its own imageUrl.

markerRadius.name: markerRadius
markerRadius.description: Meters of coverage drawn as a tinted circle around every pin, for geofences and service areas. A row may carry its own radius. 0 draws none. Default: 0

draggable.name: draggable
draggable.description: Lets users long-press and drag pins. A row may carry its own draggable. Pair it with On Marker Drag End to save the new position. Default: false

routePath.name: routePath
routePath.description: Ordered points drawn as a line across the map, read with the same latitude and longitude fields.

routeColor.name: routeColor
routeColor.description: Stroke color of the route line. Default: #2563EB

showsUserLocation.name: showsUserLocation
showsUserLocation.description: Draw the blue dot for the device location. Asks for location permission on first render, and stays off if it is denied. The recenter button shows on Google Maps only. Default: false

fitToData.name: fitToData
fitToData.description: Zoom to enclose every marker and route point instead of using the center and zoom. Default: false

height.name: height
height.description: Height of the map surface, as dp (320), a percentage of the parent (50%), or fill to take all the space the page gives it. Leave blank to fill, unless a height is set in the style panel.

interactive.name: interactive
interactive.description: Allow pan, zoom, rotate and tilt gestures. Turn it off for a map inside a scrolling page, so it cannot swallow the scroll. Default: true

onMapReady.name: onMapReady
onMapReady.description: Fires once the map surface is laid out and ready.

onRegionChange.name: onRegionChange
onRegionChange.description: Fires with the new region once the camera settles, carrying latitude, longitude, latitudeDelta, longitudeDelta, zoom, tilt, bearing and isGesture.

onMapPress.name: onMapPress
onMapPress.description: Fires with the coordinate that was tapped.

onLongPress.name: onLongPress
onLongPress.description: Fires with the coordinate that was long pressed.

onMarkerPress.name: onMarkerPress
onMarkerPress.description: Fires with the row behind the tapped pin.

onCalloutPress.name: onCalloutPress
onCalloutPress.description: Fires with the row whose callout bubble was tapped.

onUserLocationChange.name: onUserLocationChange
onUserLocationChange.description: Fires with the device position (latitude, longitude, altitude, accuracy, heading, speed, timestamp) as it updates while Show User Location is on.

onMarkerDragEnd.name: onMarkerDragEnd
onMarkerDragEnd.description: Fires when a dragged pin is dropped, with the row behind it and its new coordinate.
